\documentclass{article}
\title{Placing Idle KV Cache}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We cut the key-value (KV) cache restore time.
\end{abstract}
We measure TTFT on two GPUs.
Time to first token (TTFT) includes queueing.
Each TTFT number is a median.
The SLO (service level objective) is 2\,s.
The KV cache lives on the GPU.

GLM is the second model.
